purpose: Prevent otherwise valid temporal/LOD/aliasing evidence from being scored after the visual candidate changes. Temporal evidence must be bound to the same current candidate SHA-256, candidate epoch and persisted scene bytes as the fresh native-4K still packet. This is provenance enforcement only and awards zero Visual Fidelity points.

captureBinding.trigger: Import of Assets/QA/temporal_runtime_evidence_receipt.json schedules a post-import coherence seal attempt.
captureBinding.currentStillRequirement: QualityBlockRenderCandidateFreshnessQA.ValidateCurrentCandidateFreshness must pass before a temporal coherence seal can be written.
captureBinding.candidateIdentity: render_candidate_seal.candidateCombinedSha256 must equal render_candidate_epoch.candidateCombinedSha256 and both must share the same candidate epoch UTC.
captureBinding.timeFloor: temporal runtime generatedUtc must be >= both the candidate mutation UTC and the current candidate latest tracked input write UTC.
captureBinding.receiptBinding: coherence seal stores SHA-256 of the exact temporal runtime receipt bytes.

staleEvidenceScenarioClosed.scenario: A native-4K temporal sequence is valid, then a scene/material/shader/project-render-setting/formal-capture input changes and fresh stills are later captured for the new candidate while the old temporal sequence remains on disk.
staleEvidenceScenarioClosed.expectedResult: FAIL_CLOSED. The still candidate freshness/epoch changes; the old temporal coherence seal no longer matches and its generatedUtc predates the new candidate epoch/latest tracked input. Fresh temporal rendering is required.
